summary: RFC 5328 registered the URN namespace dvb for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project. This document updates that registration with new registrant information.

plainLanguage.summary: The contact details for the DVB URN namespace had changed. This RFC updates the registration fields while leaving the other fields unchanged.

questions: what is the dvb urn namespace
what does rfc 7354 change in rfc 5328
who is the dvb urn registrant
what contact information changed in rfc 7354
subtitle: Updates the registrant information for the DVB URN namespace.

tldr.problem: The contact information registered for the DVB URN namespace had changed since RFC 5328.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 7354 replaces the registration version and registrant fields and adds a reference to the registry entry.
tldr.outcome: The rest of the RFC 5328 registration remains unchanged; this document updates RFC 5328.

today: RFC 7354 is an Informational document that updates RFC 5328. The unit metadata does not list it as obsoleted or updated.

sections.title: Why the Registration Was Updated
sections.content:
RFC 5328 registered the dvb URN namespace for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project. The registrant's contact information changed after that RFC was published.

RFC 7354 updates the registration with current information and uses a role-based email address to reduce the need for future updates.
sections.plainLanguage: The registered contact information was no longer current. This RFC updates it and uses a shared role address.

sections.title: The Replacement Fields
sections.content:
The update replaces the Registration Information and Declared registrant of the namespace fields from RFC 5328. The new registration has version 2 and date 2014-08-11.

Peter Siebert is named as the registrant, and the contact email is dvb@dvb.org. All other registration fields remain as specified in RFC 5328.
sections.plainLanguage: The registration now has version 2 and new contact details. All other fields stay as they were.

sections.title: IANA and Security Notes
sections.content:
IANA added RFC 7354 as a reference alongside RFC 5328 in the Formal URN Namespaces registry entry for dvb. The reference field now contains two RFC numbers.

The RFC states that the registration update has no security considerations.
sections.plainLanguage: The registry now points to both RFCs for the dvb namespace. The RFC says the update has no security considerations.

references.text: Adolf, A. and P. MacAvock, "A Uniform Resource Name (URN) Namespace for the Digital Video Broadcasting Project (DVB)", RFC 5328, September 2008.
